name: Airwallex Developer
description: The Airwallex Developer Model Context Protocol (MCP) server helps developers to easily integrate with Airwallex capabilities by bringing Airwallex documentation, API references, and sandbox testing tools directly to Claude. Enjoy developer lifecycle support from knowledge search, to troubleshooting, to simulations and go-live testing. Use your sandbox credentials to get started!

_published_faq.name: How do I add Airwallex Developer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Airwallex Developer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-demo.airwallex.com/developer. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Airwallex Developer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Airwallex Developer provides these MCP tools: create_transfer, list_transfers, simulate_transfer_result, list_beneficiaries, get_fx_quote, list_global_accounts, get_balances, simulate_create_deposit, create_payment_link, list_payment_links, search_public_docs, and read_integration_best_practices.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Airwallex Developer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Airwallex Developer in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Airwallex Developer MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Airwallex Developer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Airwallex Developer is developed by Airwallex. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
